description: When target object not visible, systematically visit each location
content: Move to each listed location and observe its contents before deciding next action. Do not repeat look at same spot.

title: Use "move" command for placement
description: When placing an object onto a surface
content: After picking up an object, use the "move [object] to [location]" command instead of "put [object] on [location]" to successfully place it.

title: Use correct verb for object interaction
description: When an action fails, try synonyms or alternative verbs.
content: If "pick up" or "put" fails, try "take" or "move" instead. The environment may require a specific verb to interact with objects.

title: Pick up target object before cooling
description: When task requires cooling an object, first take it into inventory
content: Take the object you need to cool before attempting to cool it. The cooling action requires the object to be in your inventory, not on a surface.

title: Examine containers before moving on
description: When searching for an object in a container, inspect its contents first.
content: After opening a container, use "examine" to list its contents before leaving. This prevents missing target objects and avoids redundant searches.

description: When an object is visible but "pick up" fails
content: In text environments, "pick up" may not be recognized. Use "take <object> from <container>" to successfully acquire an item.
